notes:
Scope: the package binds the self-contained concrete device in the pinned clone, the static Gazebo RGB camera experiment_camera, and captures its primary output /experiment_camera/image_raw (sensor_msgs/Image) through the stock bounded local-artifact path. The card's planning hints (Simulation.* and TablesDemoAPI.*) were not bound: that stack drives a mobile manipulator through external mobipick_api/robot_api/MoveIt/Gazebo packages that are not in this clone, and the clone declares no source-backed acknowledged stop for that motion (tables_demo_planning/nodes/task_server_node.py:92-93 only clears planning goals from its actionlib preempt callback). The camera is read-only and has no actuation. No live ROS, Gazebo, camera or hardware run was performed; reviewed_by remains null and every hardware backend is refused. Fake evidence is contract_checked only. The fake is an F0 ROS-free scripted transport: it returns a 4x3 RGB8 placeholder frame (placeholder pixels and header) and is not a captured recording or a Gazebo render. The real launch defaults are 1280x720 (URDF/launch defaults, configurable); a full frame is 2,764,800 raw bytes and needs an operator artifact store larger than the SDK's 2 MiB default. NOT COVERED: camera_info/calibration, camera pose and pose tuning, exposure or runtime settings, the frame/video recorders, the tables-demo planner and robot motion, and live ROS graph/remapping. The only warning is G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the driver has no numeric actuating input to probe; no G4 provenance warning remains.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the ROS 1 image binding (/experiment_camera/image_raw as sensor_msgs/Image from libgazebo_ros_camera with robotNamespace / and cameraName experiment_camera, experiment_camera.urdf.xacro:25-49 and README.md:3-5), all seven facts, the passive R1 scope against the card floor, the 16 MiB message and 8 MiB image bounds against the 1280x720 R8G8B8 launch default, and the fake against the ROS 1 Image definition (Header.seq, stamp secs/nsecs, rgb8). Three facts said more than their lines: 'a deployment may override them' and 'so the resolved sensor dimensions are deployment configuration' were inferences, and the recorder fact claimed a subscription that is in frame_recorder.py, not on the cited camera.launch:26-28, which only starts the recorder when record is true and passes it image_topic. The reviewer rewrote those three facts in driver.py and facts.md and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the gate and collect.py --strict pass with the digest unchanged. A probe with the image topic silent (Gazebo paused) showed the resource read returning an empty state at once and the capture ending cancelled at its 2 s budget, with no frame invented. For the human reviewer: Passive simulated camera only; no actuation and no stop. The tables-demo planner and the Mobipick robot (external mobipick_api/robot_api/MoveIt packages) are not covered. A full 1280x720 frame needs an operator artifact store above the SDK's 2 MiB default; the capture is cancelled after 2 s when Gazebo is paused and the topic is silent.
